Subject: High error rate & latency spikes affecting inference (03/01 07:45-08:30 PT)

Hi Nikhil,

We started seeing elevated 5xx rates and large latency spikes for our inference calls this morning around 07:45 PT. The errors peaked at ~18% and tail latency pushed requests over 5s for many critical endpoints. This impacted our ingestion pipeline and caused a downstream job failure for several customers.

Estimated impact: ~12% of hourly traffic affected, three customer-facing jobs delayed ~30–45 minutes. We rely on the Redwood hosted endpoints for production inference. Please confirm the root cause and let us know what remedy you can offer — we need credits or a trial extension to make our Q1 commitments whole while we work through customer escalations.

I've attached a short CSV with sampled request IDs and timestamps.

Thanks,
Aisha

Thanks for escalating. Root cause: a kernel patch interaction we rolled Friday night; fix deployed at 08:40 PT.

I support customer-facing relief. Recommendation:
- Apply a one-time credit equal to 35% of Odyssey's estimated spend for the affected billing period (our read: ~$15k).
- Apply a 30-day seat trial extension for any seats created in March related to their remediation efforts (no additional invoices for that month).
- Attach an incident summary PDF for their records.

Please route the billing adjustment to Ben to create the credit note. Notify Aisha with the remediation summary and the credit details.

Subject: Resolution & account remedy for PD-78123 (Odyssey Health)

Hi Aisha — thanks again for your patience while we triaged PD-78123. Below is the agreed remediation and next steps.

What happened (summary):
- Between 07:45–08:30 PT on 2027-03-01 we observed an autoscaling regression after a kernel patch deploy that caused pod readiness delays on a subset of nodes. This increased queueing and caused elevated 5xx (~18%) and tail latency spikes. Root cause fix deployed at 08:40 PT.

Remedy applied:
- One-time account credit equal to 35% of your estimated spend for the affected billing period (credit applied: $15,000).
- 30-day free extension for any new seats created in March related to remediation work (no invoice for those seats for the extension period).
- We've attached a concise incident summary and the billing adjustment stub.

Attachments: incident-summary-OD-2027-03-01.pdf; billing-adjustment-stub-OD-2027-03-01.xlsx

Next steps for your team:
- Please confirm receipt and accept the credit memorandum (procurement@odysseyhealth.io). Once procurement confirms, Ben will route the credit into billing queue BK-4921 and the credit will post to your account within 3 business days.
- If you'd like a technical debrief call for engineers, we can schedule with Laura and the infra team — propose Thu 03/04 10:00 PT.

We're sorry for the disruption. If there is anything else we can do to limit customer fallout, let me know and we'll prioritize.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
